summary_en: CRESCO increased shares to be cancelled from 1 million to 2 million shares, representing 5.1% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026. The cancellation is scheduled for December 2, 2026.
summary_jp: 消却株式数を100万株から200万株に引き上げ。9月30日時点の発行済株式数に対する比率は5.1％。消却予定日は2026年12月2日に確定。

summary_en: FY3/27 interim dividend raised from ¥35/share to ¥45/share (¥35 ordinary + ¥10 commemorative to mark 30 years since listing); full-year dividend ¥80/share (interim ¥45 + year-end ¥35). Commemorative dividend recognizes shareholder support over three decades.
summary_jp: FY3/27中間配当を¥35/株から¥45/株に引上げ（普通配当¥35+30周年記念配当¥10）。年間配当¥80/株（中間¥45+期末¥35）。記念配当は上場30周年の株主感謝を表す。
tag_en: Dividend Policy - FY3/27 interim dividend raised to ¥45/share (¥35 ordinary + ¥10 commemorative); full-year ¥80/share
tag_jp: 配当方針：FY3/27中間配当を¥45/株に引上げ（普通配当¥35+記念配当¥10）；年間¥80/株
